rejectCriteria: six legs, duplicated limbs, or overlapping arms that read as extra legs
forelimbs touching the ground or quadrupedal stance
huge theropod hook hands instead of short lifted five-finger hands
predator head, sauropod head, generic lizard drift, or monster teeth
